items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: Oh I don't know that they, they brought those fellas there you see.

ctx.x: No no I mean Fats Houston and Slowdrag, the big guy.

Oh I don't know that they, they brought those fellas there you see. But now that's what, that's what all the hump was. That was all the kick about. The club didn't want to march behind them. They didn't want to do the, put their own grand marshal there but this little fella there?
The fella that signed the contract? Yeah. Jaffe, you're on Jaffe.
